question: In 2023, Praveen Chithravel won the men’s triple jump event at the ‘Prueba de Confrontacion’ athletics meet held in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cuba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2023, **Praveen Chithravel **participated in the ‘**Prueba de Confrontacion**’ athletics meet in Cuba, where he excelled in the men’s triple jump event.
 
• The ‘Prueba de Confrontacion’ is an athletics competition that brings together athletes from various countries to compete in multiple track and field events.
